jobs.prompt: Update tests/gpu.test.mjs. The modules changed to implement docs/plans/swarm-gpu-memory-plan.md section 7 (read the module files in your context: tools/gpu.mjs, tools/gpu-bakeoff.mjs, tools/gpu-commands.mjs, bench/gpu-bakeoff/vast.mjs). coordination/review/test-failures.txt lists which assertions failed against the new code. Return the COMPLETE updated test file (whole file, not edits), keeping every test that still holds and updating the expectations and fakes of the failing ones to the new behaviour (do not weaken a safety assertion; add assertions for the new behaviour where it is easy). Facts: LEVELS are now 32, 64, 96, 128, 192; agentsPerGpu is the highest level with error rate at most 5% and msPerToken (1000 / tokPerSecPerAgent) at most 35; runBakeoff runs every candidate (no NVFP4 extra filtering), sweeps all levels (cacheStats after each level adds cacheHitRate to the level), then runs the benchmark for best-of counts [1, 3] by default under withLoad at chosenAgents (the highest passing level, else the smallest level); optional candidates are skipped when the time left (cap minus spent, divided by the hourly price) is under minRemainingHours; ranking is ascending cost per passing task then higher agentsPerGpu; the SHORTLIST is now the three NVFP4 entries qwen3.6-35b-a3b-nvfp4 (nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4), nemotron-3.5-lightning-nvfp4 (nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4) and qwen3-coder-next-nvfp4 (RedHatAI/Qwen3-Coder-Next-NVFP4, optional) with args and env; PINNED_IMAGE is vLLM v0.31.0; the scripts add --gpu-memory-utilization 0.93 and the common args; container offers must also have pci_gen >= 5, pcie_bw >= 45, cpu_cores_effective >= 16, cpu_ram >= 65536, disk_space >= 200 and NVMe (disk_name containing nvme or disk_bw >= 1500).
